claim_boundary: The classifiers in this file are disposable verifier-side probes. Their action labels and old/new provenance labels were never supplied to the controller training run.

nearest_memory_distance.interpretation: Nearest-prototype distance is too weak to be a reliable novelty gate.

old_new_source_probe_accuracy.interpretation: Workspace state contains a strong old/new routing signal, but this is not itself evidence that it contains the correct action.

correct_action_probe_accuracy.interpretation: The correct action is partially decodable; the parent adapter latent is more useful than raw workspace alone.

conclusion: The missing boundary is not simply absence of workspace information. Workspace makes old/new provenance highly separable, and action information is present when the inherited adapter latent is included, but sparse attempted-action reward does not yet learn a clean plasticity/routing policy. Positive-outcome reweighting helps modestly; span-eight rehearsal during the span-nine run hurts at this budget. The next high-ROI change is a verifier-free action-conditioned critic or other denser use of the same observed reward, with retention gates kept as acceptance tests.
